advanced: ADVANCED TECHNIQUE X, eight frames ready/anticipate/guard/respond/peak counter/follow-through/recover/ready. signature: SPECIAL K, eight frames ready/deep crouch charging/arms rise/explosive playing/peak forward lean/resonant follow-through/recover/ready.
